## 简体中文

### 新增

- 开始菜单沿任务栏边缘显示 Windows 风格的定向进入、退出、缓动和轻微透明度过渡动画。
- 用 Windows 风格浮窗替换原生 macOS 开始按钮右键菜单，并保留电源子菜单。

### 修复

- 将开始菜单和开始按钮右键菜单定位到同一任务栏角落，并采用 Windows 风格的屏幕与任务栏间距。
- 首次显示应用缩略图预览前等待 Windows 默认的 400ms 稳定悬停，同时保留应用间切换时较短的延迟。
- 指针提前离开时取消待显示的缩略图预览；打开开始菜单前关闭所有预览界面。

## English

### Added

- Animated the Start menu along the taskbar edge with Windows-style directional entrance, exit, easing, and subtle opacity transitions.
- Replaced the native macOS Start button context menu with a Windows-style flyout and retained Power submenu.

### Fixed

- Anchored the Start menu and Start button context menu to the same taskbar corner with Windows-style screen and taskbar spacing.
- Waited for the Windows-default 400ms stable hover before showing the first app thumbnail preview, while preserving the shorter cross-app switch delay.
- Canceled pending thumbnail previews when the pointer leaves early and closed all preview surfaces before opening the Start menu.
